mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO EVAL_ASSIGN_ITEM (batch_id, eval_user_id, eval_user_name, eval_user_tag, eval_user_dept, be_eval_user_id, be_eval_user_name, be_eval_dept, be_eval_tag, weight_tag, score_type, score, submitted, submit_time) VALUES
(#{i.batchId}, #{i.evalUserId}, #{i.evalUserName}, #{i.evalUserTag}, #{i.evalUserDept}, #{i.beEvalUserId}, #{i.beEvalUserName}, #{i.beEvalDept}, #{i.beEvalTag}, #{i.weightTag}, #{i.scoreType}, #{i.score}, #{i.submitted}, #{i.submitTime})
mapper.select: SELECT i.batch_id AS batchId, b.task_type AS taskType, b.batch_name AS taskName, i.be_eval_dept AS dept, COUNT(*) AS pendingCount, b.deadline AS deadline FROM EVAL_ASSIGN_ITEM i JOIN EVAL_ASSIGN_BATCH b ON i.batch_id = b.batch_id WHERE i.eval_user_id = #{evalUserId} AND i.submitted = 0 AND b.status = 0 AND b.deadline IS NOT NULL AND b.deadline > NOW() GROUP BY i.batch_id, b.task_type, b.batch_name, i.be_eval_dept, b.deadline ORDER BY b.deadline ASC, i.batch_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVAL_ASSIGN_ITEM WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}

SELECT eval_user_id FROM EVAL_ASSIGN_ITEM WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND eval_user_id IS NOT NULL AND eval_user_id != '' UNION SELECT be_eval_user_id FROM EVAL_ASSIGN_ITEM WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND be_eval_user_id IS NOT NULL AND be_eval_user_id != ''
